description:
Executor the desktop workflow application for Windows. Speed up your daily workflow, opening things and doing things.

Executor the desktop workflow application for Windows. Speed up your daily workflow, opening things and doing things.

Key Features:
- Launch applications, files, folders, websites, web services (with parameters) and prompts in milliseconds.
- Trigger multiple actions with one text command and/or hotkey.
- Let's be an expert in opening up the world instead of trying to put the whole world inside of Executor (as some alternatives try to do).
- Take the clipboard to a new level, swiftly trigger system commands, do fast calculations, manage running applications and more.
- Tailor keywords, appearance, hotkeys, and behavior to perfectly match your daily workflow.
- Customize the look and feel with various skins and theming options to match your desktop setup.
What's new
- Pre-Black-Friday bonus feature, don't spill your coffee, Executor now has Plugins support. While Executor's "stay on target" stance portrays plugins as the devil's work, a more relaxed stance is that now when AI can easily bake plugins for everyone, then why not let "people" build and use them, but still make sure Executor is unaffected in terms of performance when no plugins are used, and keeping the plugins support footprint lightweight (added about 130KB to Executor.exe). Executor's built-in features will still never rely on plugins.
  Follow this Plugins link to the Docs for more details.
- Added Notes spell checking, right click words, select some text and right-click and select "Check spelling" or press F7. With no text selected the entire text will be checked with F7 etc. Spell checking uses the current Windows input language.
- Added that you can zoom Notes text using Ctrl+[+,-,0] and use Ctrl+Scrollwheel. Also available in the Notes right-click menu.
- In the Notes window right-clicking the Notes text now has a "Settings" option that will open Notes settings (where you can change Notes colors etc.).
